description: Upload artwork and check that it prints well on one product placement. Send exactly one of: artwork with svg (markup, best for text and logos), base64 (a PNG, JPEG or SVG file up to about 2 MB, no data: prefix) or url (a public HTTPS link to the file); file (a file object from your client); or upload_link:true when you cannot send the file in this call. Returns artwork_id and PASS/WARN/FAIL checks: print size in mm, resolution (DPI), print and safe area, transparent background, contrast with the product colour. For photos and AI images use preset center_chest. Use the artwork_id in quote.

artwork.description: New artwork to upload: exactly one of svg, base64 or url.

base64.description: Base64-encoded PNG, JPEG or SVG file contents, no data: prefix. Only for files up to about 2 MB; for larger files use url, file or upload_link.

svg.description: Inline SVG markup. Best for logos and text.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL of a PNG, JPEG or SVG file.

artwork_id.description: Re-validate artwork uploaded earlier, or validate the file of an upload link.

color.description: Product colour, for the contrast check.

file.description: A file that your client gives you as a file object (for example in ChatGPT).

download_url.description: Temporary HTTPS link to the file.

left_mm.description: Distance from the left edge of the print area. Default: horizontally centred.

placement.description: Print location on the product, e.g. "front" or "back". See get_product for the list.

preset.description: Named position inside the placement, e.g. "center_chest", "left_chest", "full_front". Defaults to the placement default.

size.description: Garment size, e.g. "XL". Print areas can differ by size; without it the smallest size is checked.

top_mm.description: Distance from the top of the print area to the top of the artwork.

upload_link.description: Set true when you cannot send the file in this call. The answer gives an artwork_id and a one-time upload_url: upload with curl, or give the link to the person. Then call validate_artwork with the artwork_id.

width_mm.description: Exact printed width of the visible artwork in millimetres. Height follows the aspect ratio.

name: validate_artwork

artwork_id.description: Only in the upload_link answer: the reserved id for the file.

next_step.description: What the agent should do next, in plain language.

upload_url.description: Only in the upload_link answer: the one-time upload link.

effective_dpi.description: Resolution at the printed size. Null for vector artwork.

print_box.description: Position and size of the printed artwork inside the print area, in mm.

status.description: PASS: prints well. WARN: tell the user, then continue if they agree. FAIL: fix the artwork, then validate again.

summary.description: Status and the checks in short lines; relay the gist to the user.

title: Upload and validate artwork
